title: Tech Note: Keyword Support in 4D v11 SQL
author: Josh Fletcher, Technical Support Engineer, 4D Inc.

historical_commentary.text: Keyword indexing, regex support, and efficient text search are foundational, still-relevant capabilities that 4D has continued to build on; the specific v11 SQL-era feature set described here has been substantially extended in later versions with more advanced full-text search and regex capabilities.
related_updates: 4D's text search and regex capabilities have been extended considerably in versions since v11 SQL, including further additions to the regex command set
